content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I've connected a pH meter from [company_name] to a [company_name] [product_name] using the 4-20 mA input and it works well. Now, I want to connect an ORP meter from [company_name] to a 4-20 mA input on the [product_name]. The manufacturer indicates that the range is -1000 to 1000 and the output is 4-20mA. I've set up an analog amplifier with a minimum of -1000 and a maximum of 1000, then another with 0-1000. When I get a reading of 514 on the [company_name] meter, the display on the [product_name] shows 445. Despite working on this all day, this is the closest I've gotten. Can anyone advise how I can adjust the parameters so the readings match on both devices? Regards, [user_name]
It seems you may have an extra zero in the analog multiplier. If you share your program, we can take a look. Kind regards, [user_name]
Hello [user_name], I've attached the program for the ORP sensor. Appreciate your quick response. [user_name]

If the ORP meter outputs a range of -1000 to 1000 with 4-20mA, you only need the initial analog amplifier (B006 in your program). The settings for B006 are correct. Using a second amplifier will only alter the results unnecessarily.

The issue is resolved. I tested this setup earlier in the afternoon but forgot to update the message text, so the display showed no information. After your suggestion, I tried again and this time remembered to adjust the message text. Thank you all for your help! [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Participants discussed troubleshooting analog input readings from an ORP meter made by [company_name], using a [company_name] [product_name] (version: [version_no]) with 4-20mA analog inputs. The key challenge was aligning the display value on the module with the actual meter reading. It was determined that additional analog amplifiers led to incorrect values, and initially, the configuration for the display message text was also missed, affecting visibility of results.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that the value shown by the [product_name] matches the reading from the ORP meter accurately, allowing for dependable calibration and monitoring.
